
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/20581430" title="发布于 2026-06-16 20:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure AI Search】 stopword 是什么，为什么它会影响搜索结果？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>问题描述</h1>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">在 Azure AI Search 中搜索 <code>in brief</code> 时，结果数量有时会比预期多很多。仔细查看返回结果文本，会发现有些文档和 <code>brief</code> 的关系很弱，反而只是命中了 <code>in</code> 这类高频词。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="393" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260616201842507-1521305017.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>这不是数据问题，也不是 Azure AI Search 的 bug。关键在于一个很容易被忽略的地方：<code>in</code> 这类词在索引和查询时，到底有没有被当作普通 token 处理。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>问题解答</h1>
<h2 id="1-stopword-%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="14">1. stopword 是什么</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="14">stopword（停用词）是在自然语言中高频出现、但对区分文档贡献较低的词。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="14">英文里常见的 stopword 包括：</p>
<blockquote>
<pre><code class="code-line language-text" dir="auto" data-line="16">a  an  the  in  of  and  to  is  for  with  on  at</code></pre>
</blockquote>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">这类词不是“永远没有意义”，而是在大多数全文检索场景里区分度较低。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">几乎每篇文档都可能含有 <code>in</code>、<code>the</code>、<code>of</code>，用它们做关键词既不能帮助筛选相关内容，也容易把大量无关文档带进结果。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">因此在传统全文检索里，stopword 通常会在索引阶段和查询阶段一起被移除，让搜索结果更聚焦于真正有区分度的词。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="2-stopword-%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E8%A2%AB%E7%A7%BB%E9%99%A4%E7%94%B1-analyzer-%E5%86%B3%E5%AE%9A" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="22">2. stopword 是否被移除，由 analyzer 决定</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="24">Azure AI Search 里，stopword 不是全局开关，而是 analyzer 行为的一部分。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="24">字段建索引时，文本会先被 analyzer 拆成 token，查询时，搜索词也会经过 analyzer。只有两边生成的 token 能对上，才可能命中。</p>
<ul>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="26">对默认 <code>standard.lucene</code> 来说，英文 stopword 不会像语言 analyzer 那样被自动移除。<code>in brief</code> 会被保留成两个 token：<code>in</code> 和 <code>brief</code>，都参与倒排索引匹配。因为 <code>in</code> 在几乎所有英文文档里都存在，搜索结果会被大量无关文档拉宽——这不是 bug，是默认 analyzer 本来的行为。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="28">换成 <code>en.microsoft</code> 后，<code>in</code> 会作为英文 stopword 被移除，<code>in brief</code> 的有效 token 只剩 <code>brief</code>。结果通常会更聚焦，但前提是这些 stopword 在业务语义里确实不重要。</li>
</ul>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="28">所以正确的问题不是"Azure AI Search 是否支持 stopword"，而是：<strong>当前字段用的是什么 analyzer，它会不会移除 stopword？</strong></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="35">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="37">3. 实验对比(使用Analyze Text API查看结果)</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="62">调用Analyze Text API接口：</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="62">POST https://&lt;your AI Search name&gt;.search.azure.cn/indexes/&lt;index name&gt;/analyze?api-version=2026-04-01</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="62"><strong>Body:</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 第一轮
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">in brief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">analyzer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">standard.lucene</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

# 结果 -- in 没有被过滤
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@odata.context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://xxxxxxx.search.azure.cn/$metadata#Microsoft.Azure.Search.V2026_04_01.AnalyzeResult</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tokens</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">startOffset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">endOffset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    },
    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">brief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">startOffset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">endOffset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">position</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
  ]
}

# 第二轮
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">in brief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">analyzer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">en.microsoft</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

#结果 -- </span>in 被当作英文 stopword 移除</pre>
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@odata.context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://xxxxxxx.search.azure.cn/$metadata#Microsoft.Azure.Search.V2026_04_01.AnalyzeResult</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">brief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个对比能直接说明两种 analyzer 下搜索结果数量不同的原因：最终参与匹配的 token 不一样。</p>
